title: Bounded-error probabilistic space
statement: For a space bound $s$, the bounded-error probabilistic space class consists of Boolean languages decidable in bounded-error probabilistic space at most $c s(n)$ for some natural number $c$, by a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine.
hypotheses_covered: $s$ is a function from natural numbers to natural numbers
There exists a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
The machine satisfies the bounded-error space-decision condition with bound $n\mapsto c s(n)$
